'''Shoapy Hostel''' was a hostel that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanbra]], to the north of a series of [[Hangar/Legends|landing pads]]. The hostel operated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
